title: Smoke-test all eight web/ slices against live credentials
description: Supabase signup, Drizzle tenancy, Mastra completion, Stripe checkout, Resend send, an Inngest run, TanStack IDB rehydration, PostHog capture. All are structurally verified; none has ever been exercised with real keys. Largest standing risk in the skeleton.

title: Upgrade new-project.sh into a full install and configuration script
description: Today it copies, renames, git inits, and runs bd init. It should also check prerequisites, install dependencies in all three apps, seed .env.local from .env.example, install the pinned skills from skills-lock.json, and run doctor so a fresh copy is runnable in one command.
close_reason: new-project.sh is now an 8-phase installer: preflight (node>=20, corepack, rsync, bd), copy, rename, env seeding, dependency install across 3 apps, skill reinstall from skills-lock.json pins, git+bd init, doctor. Flags --no-install/--no-skills/--no-git/--no-env/--no-doctor/--minimal. Verified end-to-end: 200 files, 25 skills, 0 skill files in git, clean tree

title: Report gate readiness in doctor
description: CLAUDE.md asserts hallmark is required at G4 and intent owns G1, but nothing detects that they are not installed. Extend web/scripts/doctor.mts to read skills-lock.json plus the filesystem and report which skills are present and therefore which gates are live, the same way it reports env vars to slices.
close_reason: doctor now reports a 'loop gates' section: 9 gates, each with owner, ready/dark, and what is lost when dark. Informational (only required env vars gate exit code). Immediately caught hallmark+intent missing, and a false-negative in the plugin probe (plugins nest under cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>)

title: Fix design-review Playwright wiring and collapse the duplicate
description: The design-review agent and /design-review command both request mcp__playwright__browser_* tools; the installed Playwright MCP exposes mcp__playwright__playwright_*. No MCP server is declared in the skeleton at all (no .mcp.json, no mention in project-init), so G8's browser review cannot run in a fresh copy. The two files are also ~95% duplicate text carrying the same broken 60-line tool list.
close_reason: Declared @playwright/mcp@0.0.78 in .mcp.json; rewrote the agent tool list to the 23 verified browser_* names (dropped browser_install, removed context7 and TodoWrite); collapsed /design-review into a thin dispatcher and fixed its origin/HEAD assumption

title: Scope Recraft to SVG generation and add brandkit to project-init
description: Recraft was scoped website/-only, which undersold vector: a normalized SVG inherits currentColor and survives the token lock in web/ and admin/ too. Also add brandkit as project-init Step 10 — the one sanctioned moment to set token values, before the lock goes live.

title: Add Recraft as an optional provisioned integration
description: brandkit and imagegen-frontend-web both require an image-generation tool and the harness has none, so both skills are currently inert. Recraft fills that gap (raster + vector/SVG output, useful for logos, icons, and website/ section comps). Wire it like the other optional services: project-init step, RECRAFT_API_KEY, doctor row, env-gated degradation entry.

title: Document the tasteskill family boundaries and per-project init steps
description: CLAUDE.md names design-taste-frontend but not the other Leonxlnx/taste-skill skills the machine has installed (brandkit, imagegen-frontend-web, redesign-existing-projects). Two of them collide with the token lock or duplicate an installed skill, so an agent can pick the wrong one. Also state which design skills need a once-per-project init (the /teach-impeccable analogue) and mirror that into project-init.

title: Create a GitHub remote and push
description: History was squashed to a single root commit and the dead origin removed after github.com:benjamingregory/foundation was deleted. Nothing is backed up. Needs a new repo created (confirm before creating).

title: Install hallmark and intent in foundation itself
description: foundation documents hallmark as required at G4 and intent at G1 but never ran its own project-init, so both gates are dark in this repo. Depends on doctor reporting gate readiness so the absence is visible rather than assumed.
close_reason: Installed hallmark (1 skill) and intent (17 skills). All 9 gates now ready. Installing intent surfaced 4 conflicts the earlier audit could not see: wireframe vs hallmark, articulate vs LANGUAGE_PATTERNS, evaluate as a 4th review pass, include as a 3rd a11y source — all resolved in CLAUDE.md

title: Revisit skill curation when website/ and users arrive
description: Cut 10 of 25 skills as unreachable or duplicative. Two kept ones are aspirational rather than used: investigate (user research, no users yet) and measure (metrics/experiments, PostHog wired but no experiment layer). Three cuts are worth reversing when the project grows: improve-animations once there is an animation corpus, localize if i18n lands, evaluate if the review passes prove insufficient. Restore individually with npx skills add <source> --skill <name>, never bare add, which reinstalls the whole repo.

title: Resolve /issues and /work against bd
description: Both commands drive GitHub Issues while this project tracks work in bd. CLAUDE.md documents the precedence but the commands remain as traps. Either delete them, or gate them on the project having switched to GitHub Issues.

title: Widen .claude/settings.json allowlist to cover project-init
description: The allowlist covers pnpm, git, and gh but none of project-init's own commands: npx skills, supabase, vercel, stripe. The init skill prompts at every step as a result.
